title: FA3 model-agnostic 1..N CPU/GPU hardware portability baseline
accepted: minimum one CPU package and at least eight physical cores per qualifying CPU
one or more CPU packages discovered dynamically
minimum one NVIDIA RTX 30-series GPU or newer
one or more qualifying GPUs discovered dynamically
all newer RTX generations remain admissible when workload runtime capabilities are satisfied
live CPU core SMT cpuset NUMA memory PCIe GPU driver and runtime capability discovery
admission and placement through the existing Host Resource Broker
exact current-host topology retained only as evidence or reference deployment data
rejected_as_canonical_hardware_requireme: fixed CPU package or socket count above the minimum
static CPU ID lists or NUMA node IDs
fixed GPU count above the minimum
fixed VRAM size or SM value as the platform baseline
fixed CUDA ordinal or CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES list

supersedence.rule: Any earlier FA3 text or configuration that treats an exact CPU model, socket count, CPU list, NUMA node, GPU SKU, GPU count, PCI address or CUDA ordinal as a portable canonical requirement is superseded by this decision.
